mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates continuously as the rate level directly influences valuation models without requiring threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through strengthened corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by >0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regimes (characterized by declining industrial production), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as firms face higher input costs and reduced output, compressing profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls > 0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 900 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases > 50k and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (indicated by high GDP levels above 13,600 billion dollars), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to valuation pressures and policy tightening expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 13600.
